vendor_company: Sage Group plc (Brightpearl is a Sage business unit since Jan 2022)
hq_country: United Kingdom (Bristol, UK) with US operations in Austin, Texas
target_vertical: Multi-channel retailers and wholesalers (omnichannel ecommerce, DTC brands, retail brands scaling into wholesale and marketplaces)
pricing_model: Custom quoted, tiered annual subscription based on order volume, channels, users, and modules; implementation fees additional
starting_price_usd: Approximately $1,000-$1,200/month entry tier (custom quoted; mid-market deployments commonly $2,000-$3,000+/month plus ~$35,000 implementation)
free_trial_or_freemium: No free trial or freemium tier; demo only via sales contact
shopify_supported: Native (first-party Brightpearl-built connector); one of three partners in Shopify Global ERP Program
shopify_install_count: Approximately 52 reviews on the Shopify App Store [uncertain]
shopify_plus_partner_status: Yes - Shopify Plus Certified App Partner and member of Shopify Global ERP Program (one of only three ERP partners)
shopify_sync_direction: Bi-directional for inventory, orders, payments, fulfillments, customers; product and pricing sync can be configured one-way (Shopify->Brightpearl or Brightpearl->Shopify) or bi-directional via advanced integration
shopify_synced_entities: Products, variants, inventory levels, orders, customers, payments/refunds, fulfillments/shipments, prices (incl. Compare At and Cost), order edits, gift messages, order notes, inventory transfers (DC<->store)
shopify_multi_store_support: Yes - Brightpearl can manage inventory, prices, orders, and shipments across multiple Shopify stores per tenant
shopify_pos_support: Native Shopify POS integration; downloads POS orders into Brightpearl with channel/location mapping, refunds as sales credits, inventory transfers between DC and stores, receipts confirmed in POS auto-update Brightpearl
shopify_b2b_catalog_support: Yes - advanced integration supports Shopify B2B catalog pricing sync from Brightpearl to Shopify; also pairs with SparkLayer for deeper B2B features
shopify_markets_support: Yes - advanced pricing sync for Shopify Markets supported (per b.solutions Advanced Integration)
shopify_metafield_to_erp_field_mapping: Yes - Brightpearl is known for configurable mapping of Shopify metafields to Brightpearl custom fields; this is a documented differentiator [uncertain on full coverage]
shopify_variant_option_mapping: Variants/options mapped via SKU; product mapping section ensures accurate SKU matching between Brightpearl and Shopify
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Near real-time, webhook driven for orders and inventory updates; inventory pushes happen as stock levels change in Brightpearl
shopify_known_limitations: Some users report needing the advanced (b.solutions) integration for bi-directional product/pricing sync; minor complaints around reporting date defaults and Shopify integration polish in App Store reviews; complex/manufacturing edge cases may need partner work
etsy_supported: Third-party (via partners such as Codisto/Patchworks/Ad-Lister; no native Brightpearl-built Etsy connector) [uncertain]
etsy_native_or_third_party: Third-party (Ad-Lister listing integration covers Etsy-adjacent channels; direct Etsy is typically via Codisto or Patchworks) [uncertain]
amazon_marketplaces: Major Amazon marketplaces including US, UK, EU (DE/FR/IT/ES), CA, AU [uncertain on full list incl. JP/MX/IN]
amazon_seller_types: Seller Central FBA and FBM both supported; Vendor Central not documented as native [uncertain]
amazon_synced_entities: Listings (mapping), inventory, orders, shipments, payments, prices, FBA inventory; settlement report mapping for reconciliation
amazon_listing_creation: Primarily syncs/maps existing Amazon listings to Brightpearl SKUs; listing creation at scale typically uses Ad-Lister partner [uncertain]
amazon_buy_shipping: No in-app Amazon Buy Shipping label purchase (shipping handled via ShipStation/Shiptheory partners) [uncertain]
amazon_fba_inbound_workflow: Brightpearl supports FBA inventory via dedicated FBA warehouse per marketplace; inventory transfers to Amazon and automation rules for allocation/fulfillment of FBA inventory; FBA inbound creation workflow specifics not publicly documented [uncertain]
amazon_settlement_report_handling: Settlement reports are mapped/reconciled within Brightpearl with marketplace fees and Amazon-withheld amounts captured for marking orders as paid; APIWORX offers an Amazon Reconcile Tool add-on for deeper reconciliation
amazon_marketplace_facilitator_tax_handl: Marketplace-collected tax is identified on the settlement report and used when marking orders paid; sellers must configure accounts to differentiate Amazon-remitted tax from other transactions [uncertain on full automation]
amazon_multi_account_support: Yes - multiple Amazon marketplaces per tenant, with FBA warehouse per marketplace [uncertain on multiple separate seller accounts]
amazon_known_limitations: Brightpearl has not added new marketplace integrations recently (some sources note ~6 years since adding a new marketplace), so newer channels like TikTok Shop require partner connectors; settlement reconciliation often needs add-on tooling like APIWORX
xero_supported: Third-party connector built and maintained by b.solutions (a Brightpearl partner); also competes with Brightpearl's own built-in retail accounting module
xero_app_store_certified: Listed on Xero App Store [uncertain on certification badges]
xero_synced_entities: Contacts, products, inventory, sales invoices and credits, purchase invoices and credits, sales payments and refunds (bi-directional payment/refund sync)
xero_accounting_sync_mode: Invoice per order (sales and purchase invoices are synced individually) [uncertain whether summary journal mode is offered]
xero_cogs_journal_method: Perpetual per movement - Brightpearl posts inventory movements/COGS in real time; landed costs flow through inventory valuation in Brightpearl and post to Xero accordingly [uncertain on exact Xero posting cadence]
xero_multi_currency: Yes - Brightpearl supports multi-currency and Xero connector handles multi-currency invoices [uncertain on full coverage]
xero_tax_handling: Tax codes mapped between Brightpearl and Xero per configuration [uncertain on detailed mapping]
xero_known_limitations: Integration is partner-built (b.solutions) rather than first-party Brightpearl, so feature parity and support may differ; specific limitations not publicly documented in detail [uncertain]
qb_online_supported: Yes - QuickBooks Online supported (integration available via partners/b.solutions and Brightpearl app store)
qb_desktop_supported: Yes - QuickBooks Desktop sync supported [uncertain on channel: direct vs web connector]
qb_synced_entities: Invoices, bills, payments, customers, vendors, inventory adjustments, credits [uncertain on full entity list]
qb_cogs_journal_method: Perpetual per movement via Brightpearl's real-time inventory accounting [uncertain on QBO posting cadence]
other_ecom_channels: Native/built-in connectors for Shopify, Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Magento (Adobe Commerce), Amazon, eBay, Walmart; partner connectors for WooCommerce, TikTok Shop (Patchworks), Newegg, OnBuy, B&Q; Ad-Lister covers multi-channel listing including Etsy and TikTok
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: Yes - via the Bill of Materials app: assembly/disassembly of finished products from components, auto-assembly on sales order creation or min stock level, with real-time inventory and accounting adjustments
other_accounting_integrations: Sage Intacct (parent ecosystem, Plug & Play), Brightpearl's own native retail accounting module; partner-built connectors for other Sage products [uncertain on Zoho Books, MYOB, FreshBooks, NetSuite, Wave]
bom_support: Yes - via the Bill of Materials add-on app (built by b.solutions, sold through Brightpearl)
multi_level_bom: Yes - supports sub-assemblies and sub-components, with multiple recipes per BOM
production_orders: Assemblies (auto or manual) act as production/work orders; no full routings/operations/MRP - Brightpearl is assembly-focused rather than discrete manufacturing
batch_lot_tracking: Yes - lot and expiry tracking supported, with GS1 barcode support
bin_location_support: Yes - native bin tracking with Aisle.Bay.Shelf.Bin location model (AAAA.BBBB.CCCC.DDDD format); supports location barcodes
multi_warehouse: Yes - multiple physical warehouses, each with their own location set; shared location codes allowed across warehouses
barcoding: Yes - barcode generation, location barcodes, composite and GS1 barcodes, handheld scanner support for receiving, picking, packing, counting; audio alerts to prevent wrong-item picks
purchase_orders: Yes - PO creation, partial receipts, blind receiving, QC checks, over-receiving controls, supplier price lists, drop-ship POs
supplier_management: Yes - supplier records with lead times, supplier-SKU mapping, supplier price lists, MOQs, multi-supplier per product [uncertain on full MOQ depth]
landed_cost_support: Yes - landed costs allocated across PO line items, flows through to inventory valuation, sales costing, and accounting; reconciliation tools provided
multi_currency_inventory_valuation: Multi-currency accounting and PO support; inventory valuation held in base currency with FIFO costing [uncertain on per-currency valuation]
ai_demand_forecasting: Yes - Smart Replenishment / Inventory Planner uses historical sales across channels to forecast demand up to a year ahead, factoring lead times, seasonality, promotions, and cross-channel data; Q2 2025 update added TikTok Shop trend analysis and 15-minute prediction refresh [uncertain on specific Q2 2025 details]
ai_purchase_order_suggestions: Yes - automatically generates purchase order suggestions / replenishment recommendations based on forecast
public_api: Yes - public REST API (HTTP/JSON, REST principles) documented at api-docs.brightpearl.com covering products, orders, inventory, warehouse, accounting, contacts, etc.
webhook_event_coverage: Yes - public webhook API allowing third parties to subscribe to Brightpearl state-change events; documented webhook POST and simulate endpoints
integration_architecture: Native (Brightpearl-built first-party connectors for Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, Amazon, eBay, Walmart, ShipStation) plus a strong partner ecosystem (b.solutions, Patchworks, APIWORX, Codisto, Zynk) for extended/iPaaS integrations
zapier_make_support: Limited/partner-driven - integration via Patchworks iPaaS, Zynk, or custom API work; no first-party Zapier app prominently documented [uncertain]
mobile_app: Brightpearl POS app exists (iOS App Store); broader Brightpearl operations primarily web-based [uncertain on dedicated ops mobile app]
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: Brightpearl supports barcode-driven warehouse workflows on handheld scanners, tablets, and desktop natively; dedicated mobile scanner apps also available from partners (ScanForce WMS, ScanCheck)
rate_limit_handling_documented: Brightpearl publishes API rate limits and throttling guidance in its developer docs [uncertain on Shopify/Amazon/Xero/QBO-specific rate-limit handling documentation]
sync_frequency: Real-time / near real-time for Shopify orders and inventory (webhook driven); Amazon, eBay, Walmart on frequent polled cycles; Xero/QBO sync typically real-time or scheduled depending on connector configuration [uncertain on exact cadences]
shipping_carrier_integrations: Native connectors for ShipStation, Shiptheory, Parcelhub, StarShipIT, and direct integrations with Royal Mail, FedEx, UPS, DHL and 30+ carriers via ShipStation; FBA for Amazon fulfillment
shipping_label_buying: In-app pack bench supports printing packing sheets, embedded labels, and multi-package shipments; label purchase typically handled via ShipStation/Shiptheory rather than direct in Brightpearl [uncertain]
three_pl_integrations: Amazon FBA (native), plus partner/native connectors for 3PL providers; Extensiv (formerly 3PL Central) lists a Brightpearl integration; ShipBob-specific native connector not documented [uncertain]
edi_support: Available via partner connectors (e.g., SPS Commerce, TrueCommerce via integrators) rather than first-party [uncertain]
capterra_rating: 4.4 / 5 across ~194 reviews (Ease of Use 4.4, Customer Service 4.3, Features 4.3, Value for Money 4.2)
notable_customers: Fairfax & Favor, Passenger, Run Gum, Furniture Box, USA Lab, The Flex Company, Icelantic, Casey's Distributing, Alexander Francis, The Regency Chess Company, Greater Than A; Shopify uses Brightpearl to fulfill and distribute Shopify hardware to merchants
last_major_release: Q2 2025 - Smart Replenishment / Inventory Planner update adding TikTok Shop trend analysis (via ByteDance commerce API) and 15-minute prediction refresh [uncertain on exact date]
owner_parent_company: Sage Group plc - acquired Brightpearl in January 2022 (Sage held 17% minority stake previously, paid $299M / £226M for remaining 83%)
last_funding_event: January 18, 2022 - acquired by Sage Group plc for approximately $340M total (including prior 17% stake)
public_status_page_uptime: Sage publishes a Brightpearl status page tracking 483 components across 5 groups (up/warn/down/maintenance statuses); third-party trackers (IsDown, StatusGator) have logged 169 incidents since April 2020 [uncertain on exact public status page URL and 12-month uptime %]
